## Game or change

Describe the game and the changed files.

## Validation

- [ ] Added/updated a unique entry in games.json.
- [ ] Included games/<slug>/index.html, cover and LICENSE.
- [ ] Tested on a phone or mobile browser viewport.
- [ ] Ran python scripts/build.py and python -m unittest discover -s tests.
- [ ] Kept assets within games/<slug>/ and used relative asset URLs.
- [ ] Disclosed external network requests and included third-party licenses.
- [ ] No secrets, runtime level data or server-side executables included.

## Preview

Attach a screenshot or describe how the reviewer can test the game.
